title: Mitty - HOUSEPARTY
htmlContent:
Mitty just released a "HOUSEPARTY" song for everyone to vibe with in this year 2022. Mitty has that type of music that you feel in your bones with his new song "HOUSEPARTY". The single "HOUSEPARTY" is a record that goes beyond being just nice to hear, but necessary listen for this major talent. He’s a sure fire star and it couldn’t be any more apparent than hearing his music. He excels in every aspect of his craft to make something that any one who presses play will love the energy of.
